exclusion_detail: The starting material platensimycin (1) is isolated from a 6 L fermentation of Streptomyces platensis SB12029 (not purchased); the route (HCl hydrolysis to platensic acid, DPPA Curtius, coupling with ADHBA) is therefore not from commercial starting materials.

lead.label: 7 (urea-PTM)
lead.why: No single best compound is named; the paper (title and abstract) features the urea- and carbamate-PTM analogues; urea-PTM (7), the first named and the one with the 35% route, is taken as lead. Carbamate-PTM (8) has the identical problem.

notes: Route would otherwise be 3 steps (9 from PTM; azide/isocyanate; coupling with 3-amino-2,4-dihydroxybenzoic acid), but PTM is a fermentation product.
